sql: SELECT status, count() FROM article GROUP BY status;
SELECT id, title, body, desk, status, published_at FROM article WHERE status IN ('c_11','c_23');
SELECT id, title, body, desk, status, published_at FROM article WHERE status = 'c_11' OR status = 'c_23';
SELECT id, parent, content FROM passage WHERE content CONTAINS 'kill';
SELECT id, parent, content FROM passage WHERE content CONTAINS 'pull' OR content CONTAINS 'retract' OR content CONTAINS 'withdraw' OR content CONTAINS 'spike';
SELECT id, text FROM brief WHERE text CONTAINS 'kill' OR text CONTAINS 'pull' OR text CONTAINS 'retract' OR text CONTAINS 'spike' OR text CONTAINS 'status';
SELECT article.status AS status, count() FROM brief GROUP BY status;
SELECT parent.status AS status, count() FROM passage GROUP BY status;
SELECT out.status AS status, count() FROM covers GROUP BY status;
SELECT in.status AS status, count() FROM covers GROUP BY status;
SELECT * FROM brief WHERE article = article:a33 OR article = article:a19 OR article = article:a7 OR article = article:a12 OR article = article:a28 OR article = article:a41 OR article = article:a5;
